provenance.deduplication_rule: Gen199 product code, its derived analyses and their task records are one shared-ancestry evidence family. Task opening proves routing only, not independent replication or execution.

external_primary_sources.claim_scope: The preregistered adversarial comparison directly tested divergent GNWT/IIT predictions and substantially challenged central claims of both; architectural resemblance is therefore weaker than intervention-linked discriminating predictions.

Dense retrieval exhibits literal-matching, position, brevity and repetition biases, and mitigation can fail under combined adversarial biases; this motivates lexical-boundary and multi-bias controls rather than private-probe threshold credit.
Feedback adaptation requires correction-lag and post-feedback performance measures; aggregate current accuracy does not establish a closed adaptive loop.

evidence: The fixed 0.25 admission threshold is no longer operative. A candidate now needs lexical relevance, at least two covered words for multiword questions, score >= 0.08 and score >= 0.50 of the best absolutely eligible candidate.
The change follows eight answer-bearing probes plus three unrelated and three politeness probes; it restores all eight carriers in that private set.
Current tests and ZIELE agree at 637 green / 1 red; the persistent Claude-Code adapter isolation test remains red.
substantive_delta.credit_boundary: The sweep calibrates the sampled probe set only. Relative rank does not establish evidential sufficiency, semantic recall, generalization or workspace causality.

evidence: The later Hyperposition readout is passed separately to prestage, so it can affect selection and prompts without winning a broadcast slot.
The advertised lesart candidate branch is therefore unreachable for this later readout while the same information remains visible outside the bottleneck.
substantive_delta.credit_boundary: This blocks whole global-workspace credit until wide-mode lesions prove that no answer-bearing Hyperposition payload bypasses competition.

evidence: current_user_profile separately carries projects, machine state, wiki inventory and success/failure history.
moeglichkeitsraum and gelernt_block are also injected outside broadcast.
The current design explicitly exempts only identity and present-human frame, so these richer blocks have no machine-checked FRAME/CONTROL/CANDIDATE contract.
The prestage correctly says its only content window is score/title metadata and that excerpts are withheld.
Later in the same rules it says 'you read the ausschnitt', permits choosing rank 2 because it actually answers the question and forbids rank-only choice.
Because nur_kennung removes ausschnitt, the requested content-based arbitration is impossible. The model can follow rank/title, guess, or violate one of the contradictory rules.
substantive_delta.credit_boundary: No selector-judgment credit is admissible until observation and instruction match and selector origin is logged.

evidence: Non-corpus candidates are keyed as gedaechtnis:i, verlauf:i, kollision:i and lesart:i.
Ordering changes can move a different semantic object into the same persistent learning key.
Stable memory_id, turn_id and Hyperposition relation_id already exist but are not used by the adapter.
substantive_delta.credit_boundary: Persistent non-corpus learning credit is blocked until permutation receipts prove that boosts follow objects rather than slots.

hypotheses.claim: When every answer-bearing channel competes and the selected winner is the only delivered payload, lesioning or swapping that winner selectively degrades tasks that require it.
hypotheses.falsifier: All-content lesion retains answer-specific accuracy, sidechannel lesion explains the apparent winner effect, or winner swaps do not change dependent answers.

hypotheses.claim: Correct answers attributed to broadcast can instead be reconstructed from Hyperposition, profile, possibility-space or learned-block payloads outside the bottleneck.
hypotheses.falsifier: A machine-checked channel audit classifies payload fields and all-content lesions eliminate answer-specific facts while frame/control behavior remains intact.

hypotheses.claim: With excerpts hidden, the model selector cannot make the advertised content judgment and becomes a stochastic wrapper around lexical rank/title cues.
hypotheses.falsifier: Opaque-title, position-shuffled trials show reliable selection of answer-sufficient rank-2 passages using only explicitly available non-content metadata, with no leakage channel.

hypotheses.claim: Normalizing admission to the best weak candidate can turn 'best available' into 'good enough', especially when all candidates share literal but non-supporting words.
hypotheses.falsifier: Adversarial lexical hard negatives, distributed-evidence questions and paraphrases preserve high null-output precision and answer-support recall on held-out data.

hypotheses.claim: A boost learned for one non-corpus object transfers to an unrelated object that later occupies the same positional ID.
hypotheses.falsifier: IDENTITY_PERMUTATION/v1 shows invariant semantic IDs and boost-object binding across reorder, insertion and deletion.

hypotheses.claim: The explicit instruction to always name an article ID raises the citation reward independently of factual support, reinforcing the Gen197 endogenous proxy problem.
hypotheses.falsifier: Correct-uncited answers outrank wrong-cited and forced-ID answers under independent outcome credit, and citation affects only a separate weak uptake receipt.

new_concepts.name: Workspace Channel Contract
new_concepts.definition: A machine-checked classification of every model-visible field as FRAME, CONTROL, CANDIDATE, TOOL or OUTCOME, with answer-bearing content allowed only through CANDIDATE broadcast.

new_concepts.name: Blind Arbiter Paradox
new_concepts.definition: A selector is asked to judge which passage answers the question after passage content has deliberately been hidden from it.

new_concepts.name: Relative Winner Legitimacy Fallacy
new_concepts.definition: The best candidate in a weak field is treated as sufficient because the threshold is normalized to that same field.

new_concepts.name: Slot-Memory Transfer
new_concepts.definition: Persistent credit follows a list position and is silently inherited by a different semantic object after reorder.

new_concepts.name: Sidechannel Pseudo-Workspace
new_concepts.definition: A broadcast architecture appears causally effective while answer-bearing parallel channels remain available to the deciding or answering model.
